sentences.text: The prosecutrix is the daughter-in-law of the applicant herein.
The FIR was originally registered on 25.09.2025 against ten persons, including the applicant and his son, alleging offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of IPC.

Subsequently, an allegation under Section 376 IPC was incorporated against the present applicant, on the basis of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 ["BNSS"] on 05.01.2026.
4.
The applicant and his son had earlier approached the learned Sessions Court seeking anticipatory bail.

They were both granted interim protection on 20.01.2026; however, their applications came to be dismissed by order dated 20.02.2026.
5.

The applicant's son (husband of the prosecutrix) has also filed an anticipatory bail application [BAIL APPLN. 907/2026], in which this Court has granted interim protection on 19.03.2026 with the following observations:
"5.

At the very outset, having regard to the fact that the allegations arise out of a matrimonial dispute, upon the inquiry of the Court, Ms. Rajpal and Mr. Vats submitted that the parties are willing to make an effort to settle their disputes amicably.
The father of the prosecutrix, who is physically present in Court, submits that the prosecutrix is also willing to explore the possibility of such a settlement.

6. Although Mr. Vali and Mr. Vats have opposed the application for anticipatory bail,
I am of the view that, in a matter of this nature, an attempt ought to be made to explore the possibility of an amicable resolution of the disputes between the parties.

The parties are, therefore, referred to mediation under the aegis of the Samadhan,
Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Shershah Road, New Delhi - 110503.

The parties shall appear before the learned Mediator on 25.03.2026.
8.
As noted above, the applicant was earlier granted interim protection by the learned Sessions Court on 20.01.2026, which remained in operation for a period of one month.
During this period, there is no allegation that he either avoided joining the investigation or threatened the prosecutrix or her family members in any manner.

Having regard to the aforesaid circumstances, and in order to afford the parties a fair opportunity to explore the possibility of settlement, it is directed that the applicant shall not be arrested in connection with the present FIR until the next date of hearing before this Court."

sentences.text:
I am informed that the mediation session was held today; however, the husband of the prosecutrix could not remain present as he is employed with the Military Engineering Services,
posted in Tamil Nadu, and his leave was not sanctioned.
The proceedings have, therefore, been adjourned to 07.04.2026.
Mr. Godara submits that the mediation proceedings may be conducted through video conference to facilitate his participation, in the event he is unable to appear in person.

7. Insofar as the present applicant is concerned, it is pertinent to note that the allegation under Section 376 IPC was not part of the complaint, and is not reflected in the original FIR,
notwithstanding that it pertains to an alleged incident dated 17.04.2022.

Further, having regard to the fact that mediation proceedings are underway and the parties intend to explore the possibility of a comprehensive settlement, I am of the view that interim protection is warranted at this stage.

8. It is also noted that the applicant had earlier been granted interim protection by the learned Sessions Court on 20.01.2026, and there is no allegation that he either evaded joining the investigation or sought to influence or threaten the prosecutrix or her family members in any manner.

subject to his joining the investigation, as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
10. List alongwith BAIL APPLN. 907/2026 on 04.05.2026.
